raw.name: Tomatillo Garlicky Jalepeño Crushed Pepper Sauce
raw.description:
This thick, crushed pepper hot sauce delivers bright tomatillo tang, sun-kissed jalapeño flavor, and rich garlicky depth, all balanced with a vibrant Caribbean touch. The tomatillo adds a fresh, citrusy bite, the jalapeño brings smooth, green warmth without overwhelming heat, and the garlic rounds it out with savory richness. Bold in flavor—not fire—this everyday sauce elevates tacos, salads, grilled seafood, rice bowls, and more into a tropical flavor experience.

Heat Level: Mild

Size: 5 oz.

Everything is bold and genuinely real in the Caribbean Trading Co. kitchen—no MSG, no shortcuts, just honest flavor.
Our Tomatillo Garlicky Jalapeño sauce brings Caribbean heat in a natural, balanced way. Bright tomatillos deliver a fresh, zesty tang, garlic adds deep savory richness, and jalapeños provide a smooth, green warmth without overwhelming fire.
Here in the Caribbean, flavor is always in season. Fresh ingredients, vibrant acidity, and crushed peppers come together to create a sauce that’s packed with taste—not heat overload.
Perfect for everyday use, this sauce lets pepper lovers enjoy bold flavor on tacos, grilled seafood, rice bowls, and more—bringing a true Caribbean kick to every bite.
